name: Lip combo liner and gloss routine
what_it_is: Close-up beauty videos where people demonstrate a "lip combo" — lining the lips with a pencil and topping with gloss or tint, often showing specific drugstore and brand products (creator_0470, Vivienne Sabo, Herra, Sephora Soft Suede, ABH Daydream). No single triggering moment; it's a recurring makeup routine shared across creators.
